page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr5s.24xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between the server and external storage or other network resources.

Given the high density of dedicated CPU cores and substantial memory capacity, the ecs.ebmr5s.24xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of virtualization layers. The absence of local storage and GPUs makes it a specialized choice. It is highly suited for large-scale enterprise databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis or Memcached, SAP HANA, big data analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
